archetypes.name: auth-flow
archetypes.rationale: The diff rewires Codex authentication across shared helpers, launchers, probes, and review-fix fallback paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the env-key and login authentication branches behave as intended across every touched Codex call site. Check unset versus empty OPENAI_API_KEY, auth-helper failure handling, auth.json symlink behavior, login-branch config stripping, and whether bad env-key execution fails visibly without accidentally using login auth. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: secret-surfaces
archetypes.rationale: The change promises that OPENAI_API_KEY values never reach argv, configs, logs, events, sidecars, or xtrace.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace all places where OPENAI_API_KEY presence is detected, auth arguments are built, subprocesses are invoked, and diagnostics or telemetry files are written. Look for any path that could expand, copy, echo, serialize, or preserve the secret value rather than only the variable name. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: temp-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: Multiple new temporary CODEX_HOME directories and cleanup traps create failure-path leak risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review temp directory creation and cleanup in the launchers, health probe, and review-and-fix Codex dispatch. Pay special attention to set -e, nounset, RETURN and EXIT trap interactions, early returns, fallback to Cursor, and cleanup arrays that may double-remove or miss paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: probe-cache
archetypes.rationale: Auth-mode-aware Codex probe caching and trusted-project wiring are easy to regress without obvious test failures.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Codex health probe changes for cache key correctness, stale false handling, trusted-project override parity, copied user config behavior, and helper failure behavior that should still emit usable probe results. Check whether env-key mode and login mode can incorrectly suppress or contaminate each other. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: launcher-parity
archetypes.rationale: The plan requires consistent argv ordering and auth behavior across several launcher families plus matching docs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the Codex argv spines in launch-review, launch-codex-implement, launch-codex-ci, check-reviewers, and review-and-fix. Verify the auth -c overrides, trust config, model args, output-last-message placement, and sibling documentation stay consistent where the plan requires parity and intentionally scoped where it does not. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash-compat
archetypes.rationale: The implementation uses Bash arrays, namerefs-by-name, traps, and TOML-stripping helpers under strict shell modes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the shell code for Bash 3.2 compatibility, array expansion safety, quoting, glob-splitting hazards, trap robustness, and sed or awk portability. Focus on whether helper functions behave predictably under set -euo pipefail and with unusual but valid config contents or repository paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
